YES! To Fairer Votes | YES!  To Fairer Votes was a political campaign in the United Kingdom whose purpose was to persuade the public to vote in favour of the Alternative Vote (AV) in the referendum on Thursday, 5 May 2011. Gegax served as Chairman and CEO (Head Coach) of the company and grew the business to 150 stores and $200 million in sales.
